results.title: Predict-then-Calibrate: A New Perspective of Robust Contextual LP
results.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 36
results.abstract: Risk-sensitive contextual optimization requires decisions from covariates without observing the objective at test time. The paper proposes predict-then-calibrate: first learn a prediction model, then calibrate its uncertainty to the downstream risk profile and solve a robust contextual linear program.

results.title: ARA*: Anytime A* with Provable Bounds on Sub-Optimality
results.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 16
results.abstract: ARA* rapidly finds a feasible suboptimal solution using a loose bound, then reuses search effort to tighten the suboptimality bound as time permits. It can be interrupted after a feasible incumbent exists and converges to an optimal solution given enough time.
